args.body:
• Corvid Packaging newsletter: This week's topic is retail returns logistics; links to the article at blog.corvid.example/2026/returns and notes matching case studies for readers on active projects.
• Article ("Retail returns logistics"): Apparel return rates have hit 24%; consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by about 20%.
• Companion piece: Reselling returned items within 10 days preserves most of the original margin.
args.title: Corvid Packaging: Retail Returns Logistics — Summary
